parsed_json.reasoning_summary: The bug is in the innermost loop of the Floyd-Warshall algorithm. The expression `length_by_path[i, k] + length_by_path[j, k]` incorrectly uses `length_by_path[j, k]` instead of `length_by_path[k, j]`. This leads to incorrect shortest path calculations. The fix is to replace `length_by_path[j, k]` with `length_by_path[k, j]`.

modifications.code:
length_by_path[i, j] = min(
                    length_by_path[i, j],
                    length_by_path[i, k] + length_by_path[k, j]
                )
